status: authored design hypotheses; human evaluation not run
denominator: These 26 declared v11 interface capabilities, including inherited v10 facilities. Not all GIS AI GO capabilities or every possible question.

personas.label: Resident or learner
personas.goal: Understand which place and evidence a question concerns.
personas.languageAndKnowledge: Everyday place language; expertise is not assumed.

personas.label: Policy or service planner
personas.goal: Frame a service question without unsupported household or access claims.

personas.label: Analyst or statistician
personas.goal: Check denominators, classification meaning and comparable periods.
personas.languageAndKnowledge: Comfortable with tables; geographic expertise varies.

personas.label: Geospatial or network specialist
personas.goal: Inspect native geometry, typed references, cardinality and versions.

personas.label: Data steward or engineer
personas.goal: Trace fields, nulls, sources, identifiers and interpretation changes.
personas.languageAndKnowledge: Technical data knowledge, variable subject expertise.

personas.label: Teacher or facilitator
personas.goal: Help someone practise and explain a supported interpretation.

personas.label: Auditor or reviewer
personas.goal: Separate observed evidence from proposals and unresolved claims.
personas.languageAndKnowledge: Assurance vocabulary; interface and source expertise vary.

crossCuttingNeeds.description: Keyboard, screen reader, low vision, touch and motor needs apply to every role; do not infer ability from a persona.
English fluency, vocabulary and subject expertise are independent; preserve native names and identifiers.
Novice and expert use can occur within every role; give plain explanations with inspectable technical evidence.

capabilities.story: As a resident or learner, I want an understandable starting point so I can ask a useful place question.
capabilities.expectedVisibleOutcome: Only the chosen task occupies the workspace; its purpose and safeguard are visible.
capabilities.jit: Task help
capabilities.testStatus: candidate checks recorded separately; no human outcome inferred

capabilities.capability: Choose and follow a learning stage
capabilities.story: As a teacher or facilitator, I want a goal, activity and observable outcome so I can facilitate practice.
capabilities.expectedVisibleOutcome: One selected stage shows a goal, activity, output, safeguard and evidence; previous/next change the stage.
capabilities.jit: Learning is practice, not assessment
capabilities.testStatus: candidate checks recorded separately; no human outcome inferred

capabilities.story: As a teacher or facilitator, I want alternative role prompts so I can explain the same facilities for different needs.
capabilities.expectedVisibleOutcome: The chosen role changes the authored prompt; it does not change the data or authority.
capabilities.jit: Role prompts are hypotheses
capabilities.testStatus: candidate checks recorded separately; no human outcome inferred

capabilities.story: As a resident or learner, I want to remember what I tried in this session without claiming a qualification.
capabilities.expectedVisibleOutcome: Practice ticks persist only in page memory, can be reset and clear on reload.
capabilities.jit: Not assessment or certification
capabilities.testStatus: candidate checks recorded separately; no human outcome inferred

capabilities.story: As a policy or service planner, I want to move between the supplied authority geography and statistical areas using published memberships.
capabilities.expectedVisibleOutcome: Native codes, levels and the published relationship are visible; a polygon or code selects the same record.
capabilities.jit: Organisation versus administrative area; exact-fit versus best-fit
capabilities.sourceBasis: ONS statistical and administrative geography sources
capabilities.testStatus: candidate checks recorded separately; no human outcome inferred

capabilities.story: As a resident or learner, I want to select the same area with a map, code or keyboard so a picture is optional.
capabilities.expectedVisibleOutcome: The map and code buttons retain matching selected state and focus; map selection does not assert containment.
capabilities.jit: Membership is not geometric containment
capabilities.sourceBasis: Retained boundary and lookup source declarations
capabilities.testStatus: candidate checks recorded separately; no human outcome inferred

capabilities.story: As a data steward or engineer, I want to inspect a retained identifier within the chosen area without a fresh provider request.
capabilities.expectedVisibleOutcome: Bounded pages, exact search, empty results and current/previous-property caveat remain.
capabilities.jit: UPRN is an identifier, not a count of people
capabilities.testStatus: candidate checks recorded separately; no human outcome inferred

capabilities.story: As a geospatial or network specialist, I want to distinguish relationship methods and source versions before following a native feature.
capabilities.expectedVisibleOutcome: Typed target, method meaning, source/target dates and native confidence are displayed; unobserved UPRNs stay unobserved.
capabilities.jit: Association is not building containment or road access
capabilities.testStatus: candidate checks recorded separately; no human outcome inferred

capabilities.story: As an auditor or reviewer, I want to distinguish an actual match, no match and no response so coverage is not overstated.
capabilities.expectedVisibleOutcome: Earlier query choices preserve all three outcomes and the original reservation/no-retry explanation.
capabilities.jit: Zero matches are scoped; no response is not absence
capabilities.sourceBasis: Native source contracts and retained outcome explanations
capabilities.testStatus: candidate checks recorded separately; no human outcome inferred

capabilities.story: As a geospatial or network specialist, I want native height fields and units without mistaking precision for accuracy.
capabilities.expectedVisibleOutcome: The height table keeps field names, definitions, nulls, metres and qualitative confidence; values and units stay together.
capabilities.jit: Vertical meaning and geometry CRS are separate
capabilities.testStatus: candidate checks recorded separately; no human outcome inferred

capabilities.story: As a geospatial or network specialist, I want to inspect selected Streets, Sites, Buildings and PathLinks without implying complete area coverage.
capabilities.expectedVisibleOutcome: Family filter, full native property table, diagnostic status and all retained references remain available.
capabilities.jit: Selected observations are not an inventory of every feature
capabilities.testStatus: candidate checks recorded separately; no human outcome inferred

capabilities.story: As a data steward or engineer, I want to follow exact loaded targets and preserve unresolved references.
capabilities.expectedVisibleOutcome: Loaded targets navigate to their detail; unloaded targets explicitly have no loaded geometry.
capabilities.jit: Site principal building is not all Site buildings
capabilities.sourceBasis: OS native reference fields and source versions
capabilities.testStatus: candidate checks recorded separately; no human outcome inferred

capabilities.story: As a geospatial or network specialist, I want to know what a drawn path does and does not establish.
capabilities.expectedVisibleOutcome: The original dated Street reference and PathLink native version remain distinct; requested 2D versus storage ordinate loss is visible.
capabilities.jit: No walkability, access, connectivity or right-of-way inference
capabilities.sourceBasis: OS PathLink source schema and definitions
capabilities.testStatus: candidate checks recorded separately; no human outcome inferred

capabilities.story: As an analyst or statistician, I want to count the selected cohort by a documented dimension with a complete table alternative.
capabilities.expectedVisibleOutcome: Dimension and cohort controls update the chart and table together; denominator and method are explicit.
capabilities.jit: Counts of retained UPRNs are not population estimates
capabilities.sourceBasis: ONSUD methods and dated ancillary definitions
capabilities.testStatus: candidate checks recorded separately; no human outcome inferred

capabilities.story: As a policy or service planner, I want to compare direct and best-fit assignments without replacing either with a guessed answer.
capabilities.expectedVisibleOutcome: The supplied difference example shows both native assignments and the explanation; neither is overwritten.
capabilities.jit: Direct and best-fit methods answer different questions
capabilities.testStatus: candidate checks recorded separately; no human outcome inferred

capabilities.story: As an analyst or statistician, I want to distinguish nominal RUC/OAC categories from deprivation ranks and measures.
capabilities.expectedVisibleOutcome: Native labels and classification notes stay beside counts; ranks are not displayed as deprivation amounts.
capabilities.jit: Nominal categories are not quantities; jurisdictions differ
capabilities.sourceBasis: ONS RUC/OAC and jurisdiction-specific deprivation sources
capabilities.testStatus: candidate checks recorded separately; no human outcome inferred

capabilities.capability: Compare historical BUA assignments and boundaries
capabilities.story: As a policy or service planner, I want to compare a settlement lookup with its dated boundary evidence without inventing a current crosswalk.
capabilities.expectedVisibleOutcome: Only exact BUA24CD joins are used; lookup/boundary editions, field-specific discrepancies and complete selected geometry remain visible.
capabilities.jit: Settlement is not an administrative authority
capabilities.sourceBasis: ONS historical BUA source and lookup definitions
capabilities.testStatus: candidate checks recorded separately; no human outcome inferred

capabilities.story: As an analyst or statistician, I want a not-covered category to remain distinct from rurality or outside-polygon status.
capabilities.expectedVisibleOutcome: The category has no polygon and no implied spatial complement; it remains in the counts table.
capabilities.jit: Not covered does not mean rural
capabilities.testStatus: candidate checks recorded separately; no human outcome inferred

capabilities.capability: Inspect all BUA attributes and geometry
capabilities.story: As a data steward or engineer, I want native fields, whitespace, nulls and geometry details to survive a visual comparison.
capabilities.expectedVisibleOutcome: The full retained attribute table and exact lexeme details remain; all selected rings are drawn without new simplification.
capabilities.jit: Different native strings or identifiers are not silently normalised
capabilities.sourceBasis: Historical boundary source fields and portrayal limits
capabilities.testStatus: candidate checks recorded separately; no human outcome inferred

capabilities.story: As an auditor or reviewer, I want native instance dates distinguished from polygon life and code succession.
capabilities.expectedVisibleOutcome: The chosen code can show multiple recorded instances; native date meaning, empty/absent values and source labels remain.
capabilities.jit: Code validity is not boundary validity or a crosswalk
capabilities.sourceBasis: Register of Geographic Codes and date-source definitions
capabilities.testStatus: candidate checks recorded separately; no human outcome inferred

capabilities.capability: Compare explanation routes and proposal previews
capabilities.story: As a teacher or facilitator, I want learners to distinguish an implemented observation from a suggested presentation.
capabilities.expectedVisibleOutcome: Explanation routes, earlier research notes and proposal-only chart previews keep their status labels.
capabilities.jit: A proposal is not a completed dataset or calculation
capabilities.testStatus: candidate checks recorded separately; no human outcome inferred

capabilities.capability: Inspect all evidence and journey caveats
capabilities.story: As an auditor or reviewer, I want the original source editions, journey status and coverage limits to remain inspectable.
capabilities.expectedVisibleOutcome: Original evidence text, source links and journey-status entries remain accessible in the focused sources task.
capabilities.jit: Selected-input acceptance is not full coverage
capabilities.sourceBasis: Original source editions and boundary explanations
capabilities.testStatus: candidate checks recorded separately; no human outcome inferred

capabilities.story: As a resident or learner, I want to find an unfamiliar word or code without assuming every matching label means the same thing.
capabilities.expectedVisibleOutcome: Search matches reviewed labels, definitions and aliases; entries retain source links, alias authority and scope notes.
capabilities.jit: A search variant does not establish semantic equivalence
capabilities.testStatus: candidate checks recorded separately; no human outcome inferred

capabilities.story: As an auditor or reviewer, I want to keep a definition beside another task and recover it with the keyboard.
capabilities.expectedVisibleOutcome: Pinned reference tab/query survives task changes; folding preserves state, Escape returns focus, and tab arrows work.
capabilities.jit: Pinning preserves context, not source freshness
capabilities.testStatus: candidate checks recorded separately; no human outcome inferred

capabilities.story: As a resident or learner, I want the same tasks on a narrow screen without losing labels, focus or tables.
capabilities.expectedVisibleOutcome: One workspace remains active; task/reference controls fold; tables scroll locally; no document-wide horizontal overflow.
capabilities.jit: Automated checks do not establish full accessibility
capabilities.testStatus: candidate checks recorded separately; no human outcome inferred

capabilities.capability: Reset and navigate without another request
capabilities.story: As a data steward or engineer, I want local navigation and reset to preserve the source model and make no new acquisition.
capabilities.expectedVisibleOutcome: Local hash back/forward, reset, task choices and reference changes do not mutate model bytes or call a provider.
capabilities.jit: No broad authority or endpoint is implied by a UI control
capabilities.testStatus: candidate checks recorded separately; no human outcome inferred

evaluation.automatedChecks: separate source-bound browser and preservation receipts
evaluation.authoredCoverage: all declared capabilities have a story, expected outcome, source basis, JIT concept and learning stage
